The '''''Phantom Lady''''' was a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] that passed through a powerful [[Ion storm/Legends|ion storm]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], magnetizing its [[Hull/Legends|hull]]. As a result, it began rapidly accumulating space detritus, including a [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]]-rich [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]].<ref name="Mission" />
